en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European village in a rural landscape. In the center stands a church with a bulbous (onion-shaped) tower dome and a cross on top, surrounded by farm buildings, barns with long pitched roofs, half‑timbered or plastered houses, and many trees and gardens. In the foreground are orchards or dense vegetation; in the middle ground a road or rail line runs along the edge of the settlement. Low wooded hills and fields stretch into the distance under a bright sky. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.
